key_catalyst: Meta -4.5% on AI-trade weakness/spending concerns, extending the mega-cap AI selloff (GOOGL yesterday) amid building safe-haven dollar demand
reasoning: The morning's SECTOR_ROTATION/AI-trade selloff thesis did NOT resolve intraday — it broadened: after yesterday's GOOGL -5%, today META fell -4.5% on AI-spending concerns and Netflix printed an underwhelming forecast, while the dollar drew safe-haven demand as markets turned defensive. Yet QQQ closed the session UP +0.53%, a divergence in which FX/positioning is already flashing risk-off but equities have not repriced it. What changed is the AI-trade weakness spread to a new mega-cap name; what remains unresolved is whether the defensive rotation catches equities down overnight.
